bagPolicy.summary: Bags under 20”x20”x10” are allowed at the Newport Jazz Festival. Larger bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: On site parking at Fort Adams State Park is limited and requires advance purchase of a parking pass. On site parking sales are credit card only, and cash is not accepted. Once full, attendees will be directed to an offsite satellite lot.

rideshare.note: If you use a ridesharing service such as UBER or LYFT, please follow the signs for designated dropoff and pickup locations.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Newport Jazz Festival varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Newport Jazz Festival, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Newport Jazz Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Newport Jazz Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Newport Jazz Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
